# Asteroid Dodge

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Assumes there is a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Sound assets (data URIs)
8:   const sounds = {
9:     hit: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='), // short silent placeholder
10:     power: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=')
11:   };
12:   // Background music (optional)
13:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
14:   bgMusic.loop = true;
15:   bgMusic.volume = 0.1;
16:   bgMusic.play();
17: 
18:   // Set canvas size (fallback to 800x600 if not styled)
19:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
20:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
21: 
22:   // Ship definition
23:   let score = 0;
24:   const ship = {
25:     x: canvas.width / 2,
26:     y: canvas.height - 50,
27:     radius: 15,
28:     speed: 5,
29:     color: '#00ff00',
30:     dx: 0,
31:     dy: 0,
32:     update() {
33:       this.x += this.dx;
34:       this.y += this.dy;
35:       // Keep within bounds
36:       this.x = Math.max(this.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - this.radius, this.x));
37:       this.y = Math.max(this.radius, Math.min(canvas.height - this.radius, this.y));
38:     },
39:     draw() {
40:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.radius * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.radius);
41:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
42:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#070');
43:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
44:       ctx.beginPath();
45:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.radius);
46:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
47:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
48:       ctx.closePath();
49:       ctx.fill();
50:     },
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Asteroid definition
54:   const asteroids = [];
55:   // Power‑up circles (collect for score)
56:   const powerUps = [];
57:   const POWERUP_INTERVAL = 10000; // ms
58:   let lastPowerUp = 0;
59:   function spawnPowerUp() {
60:     const radius = 12;
61:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
62:     const y = -radius;
63:     powerUps.push({ x, y, radius, speed: 1.5, collected: false });
64:   }
65:   function drawPowerUps() {
66:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
67:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.radius);
68:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
69:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
70:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
71:       ctx.beginPath();
72:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
73:       ctx.fill();
74:     });
75:   }
76:   function updatePowerUps(delta) {
77:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const p = powerUps[i];
79:       p.y += p.speed;
80:       if (p.y - p.radius > canvas.height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
81:       // check collection with ship
82:       const dx = p.x - ship.x;
83:       const dy = p.y - ship.y;
84:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
85:     if (dist < p.radius + ship.radius) {
86:           // increase score
87:           score += 10;
88:           // play power‑up sound
89:           sounds.power.currentTime = 0;
90:           sounds.power.play();
91:           powerUps.splice(i, 1);
92:         }
93: 
94:     }
95:   }
96:   // Starfield background
97:   const stars = [];
98:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
99:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
100:     stars.push({
101:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
102:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
103:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
104:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
105:     });
106:   }
107:   function drawStars() {
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:     stars.forEach(s => {
110:       ctx.beginPath();
111:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
112:       ctx.fill();
113:     });
114:   }
115:   function updateStars() {
116:     stars.forEach(s => {
117:       s.y += s.speed;
118:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
119:         s.y = 0;
120:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
121:       }
122:     });
123:   }
124:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
125:   let lastSpawn = 0;
126:   let asteroidSpeed = 2;
127: 
128:   function spawnAsteroid() {
129:     const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
130:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
131:     const y = -radius;
132:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, speed: asteroidSpeed, color: '#888' });
133:   }
134: 
135:   function updateAsteroids(delta) {
136:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
137:       const a = asteroids[i];
138:       a.y += a.speed;
139:       // remove off‑screen
140:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
141:     }
142:     // increase difficulty over time
143:     asteroidSpeed = Math.min(12, asteroidSpeed + delta * 0.00001);
144:   }
145: 
146:   function drawAsteroids() {
147:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
148:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
149:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
150:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
151:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
152:       ctx.beginPath();
153:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
154:       ctx.fill();
155:     });
156:   }
157: 
158:   function drawScore() {
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
160:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
161:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
162:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
163:   }
164: 
165:   function checkCollision() {
166:     for (const a of asteroids) {
167:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
168:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
169:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
170:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
171:         return true;
172:       }
173:     }
174:     return false;
175:   }
176: 
177:   let lastTime = performance.now();
178:   let gameOver = false;
179: 
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
182:     lastTime = timestamp;
183: 
184:     if (gameOver) {
185:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
186:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
187:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
188:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
189:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
190:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
191:       return;
192:     }
193: 
194:     // spawn logic
195:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
196:       spawnAsteroid();
197:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
198:       // gradually speed up spawning
199:       asteroidSpawnInterval = Math.max(500, asteroidSpawnInterval - 20);
200:     }
201:     // spawn power‑up
202:     if (timestamp - lastPowerUp > POWERUP_INTERVAL) {
203:       spawnPowerUp();
204:       lastPowerUp = timestamp;
205:     }
206: 
207:     // Update entities
208:     ship.update();
209:     updateAsteroids(delta);
210:     updateStars();
211:     updatePowerUps(delta);
212:     // Check collisions
213:     if (checkCollision()) {
214:           // play hit sound
215:           sounds.hit.currentTime = 0;
216:           sounds.hit.play();
217:           gameOver = true;
218:         }
219: 
220:     // Render
221:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
222:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
223:     drawStars();
224:     drawPowerUps();
225:     drawAsteroids();
226:     ship.draw();
227:     drawScore();
228: 
229:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
230:   }
231: 
232:   // Input handling (arrow keys)
233:   const keys = {};
234:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
235:     keys[e.key] = true;
236:     updateDirection();
237:   });
238:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
239:     keys[e.key] = false;
240:     updateDirection();
241:   });
242: 
243:   function updateDirection() {
244:     ship.dx = 0;
245:     ship.dy = 0;
246:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
247:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
248:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
249:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.dy = ship.speed;
250:   }
251: 
252:   // Start the loop
253:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
254: })();

</content>
